meta.source: Expenditure Budget Vol. I, Statement 2 'Total Expenditure of Ministries / Departments' (with Statement 1 'Summary of Expenditure' as a check), editions 1998-99 to 2016-17. Each edition gives the actuals of the year before last.
meta.level: Department or ministry as Statement 2 prints it, Plan plus Non-Plan; revenue and capital where printed. Not major heads.
meta.provisional: Actuals as known at budget time. Most editions mark them provisional; the audited figures are in the Union Government Finance Accounts and can differ slightly.
meta.total_definition: total_expenditure is Statement 2's Grand Total = Statement 1's Total Expenditure = Budget at a Glance's total expenditure: central sector + central assistance for State Plans + Union Territories.
meta.joins: From 2015-16 the Union's actuals are in data/union.json from the Demands for Grants. Departments here are keyed with common.dept_key, the same key union.json uses, but departments were created, split and renamed over these years; a key that stops is not a department that stopped spending.

known_gaps: The 1998-99 actuals of the departments in the 2000-01 Statement 2 add up to Rs 53.62 crore more than its printed central-sector total (2,48,387.05 against 2,48,333.43), though every department's revenue and capital add up to its own total. Budget at a Glance 2000-01 prints total expenditure of Rs 2,79,366 crore, which agrees with the printed total (2,79,365.30), so one department line is misprinted. The document does not say which.

excluded_editions.1998-99: stat02.pdf is truncated: pages 1, 4 and 6 carry about 230 characters each against about 1,900 on a full page, so most departments on them are not in the file. The departments that remain add up to Rs 62,867 crore of a printed central sector of Rs 1,75,940 crore. 1996-97 actuals are therefore not available by department.
